questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content: When rain is accompanied by a thunderstorm, the collected rain water will have a pH value :

options.content: slightly higher than that when the thunderstorm is not there
which depends on the amount of dust in air
slightly lower than that of rain water without thunderstorm
